- **Tuition deposit** rose from $1,500 (2021–22, with $500 for financial-aid applicants)
 to $2,000 (2022–23 onward, with $650 for financial-aid applicants). Source: same
 snapshots, "Tuition Deposit:" paragraph.

 states verbatim: "Cannon School will conclude its participation in the North Carolina
 Opportunity Scholarship following the 2025-26 school year." This is a material
 affordability change worth reflecting in the app.
sections.t:
- **El depósito de matrícula** subió de $1,500 (2021–22, con $500 para quienes solicitan
 ayuda financiera) a $2,000 (desde 2022–23, con $650 para quienes solicitan ayuda).
 Fuente: las mismas instantáneas, párrafo "Tuition Deposit:".
- **North Carolina Opportunity Scholarship** — la instantánea de 2026–27
 (`20260313015924`) afirma literalmente: "Cannon School will conclude its participation
 in the North Carolina Opportunity Scholarship following the 2025-26 school year." Es un
 cambio relevante de asequibilidad que conviene reflejar en la aplicación.

sections.subtopic: Note on the published 5.0% increase
at: charlotte-country-day:Note on the published 5.0% increase
sections.text:
The school states that every band rose 5.0% from 2025–26 to 2026–27. The archived
2025–26 figures are close to, but **not identical to**, what a naive 2026–27 ÷ 1.05
calculation would produce — the school rounds each band to a clean figure. Examples:
sections.t:
El colegio afirma que todas las franjas subieron un 5,0% de 2025–26 a 2026–27. Las cifras
archivadas de 2025–26 se aproximan, pero **no coinciden exactamente**, con lo que daría un
cálculo simple de 2026–27 ÷ 1,05 — el colegio redondea cada franja a una cifra limpia.
Algunos ejemplos:

sections.subtopic: Tuition History

sections.text:
**The app uses 2026-27 ($22,790, grades 9-12)** for `top-tuition` and every
tuition figure in prose, matching the 2026-27 basis used for the six existing
schools. The 2025-26 figures above exist so a reader reconciling against the
payment-terms PDF understands the two live years; no app figure mixes years.
sections.t:
**La aplicación usa 2026-27 ($22,790, grados 9-12)** para `top-tuition` y todas las
cifras de matrícula en la prosa, coincidiendo con la base 2026-27 usada para los seis colegios
existentes. Las cifras de 2025-26 anteriores existen para que un lector que las coteje con el
PDF de condiciones de pago entienda los dos años vigentes; ninguna cifra de la aplicación mezcla años.

sections.subtopic: Financial aid detail captured in the same snapshots
at: davidson-day:Financial aid detail captured in the same snapshots
sections.text:
- **Maximum award floor** — verbatim from `20240412152106`: "No financial aid award covers
 the full cost of tuition at Davidson Day School. Families receiving the 'maximum' award
 at Davidson Day are required to pay $3,000 per year, per student for tuition." The same
 $3,000 floor still appears in the 2025–26 snapshot `20250806061814`.
- **Application deadline** — February 15 each year; reapplication required annually.
- **Acclaim Scholars Program** — introduced for the class of 2030 to mark the school's 25th
 anniversary; covers 90% of tuition through graduation contingent on good standing.
 Source: 2026–27 snapshot `20260415013011`.
sections.t:
- **Suelo de la ayuda máxima** — literalmente, de `20240412152106`: "No financial aid award
 covers the full cost of tuition at Davidson Day School. Families receiving the 'maximum'
 award at Davidson Day are required to pay $3,000 per year, per student for tuition." Ese
 mismo suelo de $3,000 sigue apareciendo en la instantánea de 2025–26 `20250806061814`.
- **Fecha límite de solicitud** — 15 de febrero de cada año; hay que volver a solicitarla
 cada curso.
- **Acclaim Scholars Program** — creado para la promoción de 2030 con motivo del 25.º
 aniversario del colegio; cubre el 90% de la matrícula hasta la graduación, condicionado a
 mantener una situación académica y disciplinaria correcta. Fuente: instantánea de
 2026–27 `20260415013011`.
